related.title: MAREA：跨洋傳播延遲下限
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 每一區段均不得超過假設上限，端點恰有兩個；數量減少不等於已證明供電、OSNR或可靠度合格。 tat8_teaching_spans.csv、內部設備清單與整數取整說明 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 123 與變更 103 units、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Every span must satisfy its assumed limit and there must be exactly two shore endpoints; fewer units do not establish power-feed, OSNR or reliability compliance. tat8_teaching_spans.csv, internal-unit list and rounding justification Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 123 and changed 103 units, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學單向傳播預算35 ms；6000 km通過、7200 km不通過；低於模型下限的報告先查單位與量測方向。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching one-way propagation budget35 ms:6000 km passes and7200 km fails; a measurement below the model floor requires unit and direction checks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成線路6200 km，區段上限50 km；比較上限60 km，採均勻配置。 名義式 ceil(6200/50)-1 = 123 units；變更式 ceil(6200/60)-1 = 103 units。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用設備數加一反推平均區段長，再逐段加總到6200 km；103台時104區段約59.615 km。

以MAREA為案例背景；合成纖長6000 km、群速度2e8 m/s，繞路後7200 km；均非其公布實測。 名義式 6000*1000/2e8*1000 = 30 ms；變更式 7200*1000/2e8*1000 = 36 ms。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以每公里5 µs獨立換算；理想對稱往返分別60與72 ms，再把已知終端延遲另列。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic6200 km route, maximum span50 km; compare60 km with uniform placement. Nominal ceil(6200/50)-1 = 123 units; changed ceil(6200/60)-1 = 103 units. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Recover mean span from units plus one, then sum all spans to6200 km;103 internal units imply104 spans of about59.615 km.

MAREA motivates a synthetic6000 km fiber route at2e8 m/s, changed to7200 km; neither is a published measurement of the system. Nominal 6000*1000/2e8*1000 = 30 ms; changed 7200*1000/2e8*1000 = 36 ms. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Independently use5 microseconds per kilometer; ideal symmetric round trips are60 and72 ms before separately listed terminal delay.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: BB84：基底篩選與抽樣資源
related.titleEn: BB84: basis sifting and test resources
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 每一區段均不得超過假設上限，端點恰有兩個；數量減少不等於已證明供電、OSNR或可靠度合格。 tat8_teaching_spans.csv、內部設備清單與整數取整說明 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 123 與變更 103 units、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。

related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 匹配計數需與四格表一致；保留量增加只通過效率檢查，必須另做誤差、洩漏與有限長度安全分析。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Matching counts must agree with the table; increased retention passes only an efficiency check, with error, leakage and finite-size security analyzed separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成線路6200 km，區段上限50 km；比較上限60 km，採均勻配置。 名義式 ceil(6200/50)-1 = 123 units；變更式 ceil(6200/60)-1 = 103 units。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用設備數加一反推平均區段長，再逐段加總到6200 km；103台時104區段約59.615 km。

合成有效偵測100萬次；公平基底p=0.5，改為p=0.9；只計匹配，不把保留位元稱安全金鑰。 名義式 1e6*(0.5**2+(1-0.5)**2) = 500000 sifted bits；變更式 1e6*(0.9**2+(1-0.9)**2) = 820000 sifted bits。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 列ZZ、ZX、XZ、XX四格聯合機率，總和須1；p=0.9的XX格只占0.01，另行記錄測試量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic6200 km route, maximum span50 km; compare60 km with uniform placement. Nominal ceil(6200/50)-1 = 123 units; changed ceil(6200/60)-1 = 103 units. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Recover mean span from units plus one, then sum all spans to6200 km;103 internal units imply104 spans of about59.615 km.

Synthetic one million detections withp=0.5, changed top=0.9; count matched bases without calling sifted bits secure keys. Nominal 1e6*(0.5**2+(1-0.5)**2) = 500000 sifted bits; changed 1e6*(0.9**2+(1-0.9)**2) = 820000 sifted bits. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: EnumerateZZ,ZX,XZ,XX probabilities summing to one; atp=0.9 theXX cell is only0.01, so record its test sample separately.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
